title: LunarLander · LSTM, no speeds
description: An LSTM pilot that sees only position, tilt and leg contacts: no speeds, no spin, so it has to remember earlier ticks to know how it is moving. Taught to imitate the PPO expert (behaviour cloning + DAgger on whole episodes). Landed 76% of 50 fresh seeds (mean return 207). The recording holds two episodes; the state resets where the second one starts.
